about: Game mode component library for the map editor's drag-in panel. Keys and help live in lonerstrike.fgd (same class names). visual: how to draw it in 3D - ring (radius key), box (size key or the brush), point, beam_up (a line to the sky), link (lines to the entities named in link_keys). color is RGB 0-255. needs_nav: the editor warns when there's no nav area under it.

components.title: Safe zone
components.blurb: The circle players must stay inside.

components.title: Zone shrinker
components.blurb: Shrinks a safe zone in stages.

components.title: Damage zone
components.blurb: Fire, poison or shock that hurts players inside.

components.title: Respawn point
components.blurb: Where a team spawns in a mode.

components.title: Player class
components.blurb: Health, speed, weapons and model for a class.

components.title: Weapon spawner
components.blurb: A weapon on the floor that comes back.

components.title: Loot crate
components.blurb: Hold USE to open; gives items from a loot table.

components.title: Supply drop
components.blurb: A crate falls from the sky here.

components.title: Timed door
components.blurb: Opens, closes and locks doors on a timetable.

components.title: Trap
components.blurb: Sets off its targets when someone walks in.

components.title: Moving platform
components.blurb: Bots wait for a train or lift and ride it.

components.title: Capture point
components.blurb: Stand on it to take it for your team.

components.title: Extraction
components.blurb: Stay inside while it's open to get out.

components.title: Checkpoint
components.blurb: Race gates passed in order.

components.title: Barricade
components.blurb: A wall that breaks and can be repaired. Wraps the selected brushes.

components.title: Wave spawner
components.blurb: Where waves of enemies come from.

components.title: Perk machine
components.blurb: Sells one perk (Tough, Quick hands, Double tap, Quick revive, Light feet).

components.title: Upgrade bench
components.blurb: Upgrades the gun in hand to Mk II, then Mk III.

components.title: Mystery box
components.blurb: A random gun for a price; moves to another box of its group after a few uses.

components.title: Meeting point
components.blurb: Call a meeting, talk, vote someone out.

components.title: Creature
components.blurb: A zombie, hound, turret... from creatures.ini, back every round.

components.title: Barnacle
components.blurb: A ceiling hazard: its tongue hauls up anyone who walks into it. Place it right under a ceiling.
